findings.summary: The implementer report states 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff contains zero test files (only astro.config.mjs and the new plugin), and the repo has no test runner configured anywhere (no vitest/jest, no `test` script in package.json). I verified this by direct grep/find across the repo and git show --stat on the commit. The claim is fabricated — no automated verification exists for this change, and nothing protects it from regressing on a future edit.

findings.summary: The brief asks for 'the same not-draft-and-not-future-dated-in-Brisbane-time rule the rest of the site applies.' The canonical rule in apps/web/src/utils/data-utils.ts:12-15 has a DEV bypass (`import.meta.env.DEV || ...`) so future-dated posts preview normally in `astro dev`. This plugin's local isPublished() omits that bypass, so during local dev a link to a future-dated (non-draft) sibling post gets stripped to plain text here even while the rest of the site (index/tags/rss under DEV) would still show that post as live. Production build behavior matches exactly since DEV is false there — this only affects local author preview, not what ships.
